_doc: An entity with an outstanding memo may not be designed, prompted or shown in frame. The memo is written first. This is a hard gate and no packet, prompt or render may pass it.

memos.reason: A woman turned monstrous. How she is shown decides what the series says about women and monstrousness. Written before drawn.
Ten heads are a design problem and a theological one. Not a costume.
The mutilation scene. The memo settles what is shown and what is not, before any line is drawn.
Deformity has been used as moral signal for a century of illustration. We will not.
The curse and the stone. Consent is at issue in the passage and in every retelling.
The largest design decision in the project. Not taken in passing.
The line between person and animal. Every choice here is read racially whether we intend it or not.
Gold city. Every prior depiction imports an orientalism we have to decide about first.
Weapons that are also persons. A VFX answer would be the wrong answer.
The being that rises from the sacrificial fire in Bala. Its form is not settled in the text.
